options.content:
- This data is loaded at 5 minute intervals from [RDS Performance Insights](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/performance-insights/)
- For details on how to interpret this data, see [Analyzing Amazon RDS Database Workloads with Performance Insights](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/database/analyzing-amazon-rds-database-workload-with-performance-insights/)

panels.title: Current DB Load Relative to Num VCPUs
DB Load Relative to Num VCPUs

panels.description: Session types by AAS (Average Active Sessions)

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.session_type.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("session_type") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.session_type.name" ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top Session Type

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.user.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("user") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.user.name" ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 10

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.application.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("application") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.application.name" ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 10

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.host.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT AVG("host") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.host.name" ORDER BY AVG() DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Wait events by AAS (average active sessions)

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.wait_event.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("wait_event") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.wait_event.name"

panels.title: Top Wait event

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("name") FROM "/AuroraMonitoringGrafana/PerformanceInsightMetrics" GROUP BY "db.name" ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description:
SQL load by AAS (average active sessions)
* Data limited to now-3h due to Cloudwatch limitations

defaults.noValue: Data limited to now-3h due to CloudWatch limitations. Try a more recent time range.

names:
4 - 'SELECT
              orders.id
          FROM
              orders
          INNER JOIN patients ON patients.id = orders.patient_id
          INNER JOIN phones ON phones.patient_id = patients.id AND regexp_replace(phones.phone_number, ?, ?, ?) ILIKE ?
          WHERE
              orders.practice_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'

targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX(sql_tokenized) FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.sql_tokenized.statement" ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top SQL

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.application.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("application") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.application.name"

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.user.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("user") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.user.name" ORDER BY MAX() DESC

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.session_type.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("session_type") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.session_type.name"

targets.label: ${PROP('Dim.db.wait_event.name')}
targets.sqlExpression: SELECT MAX("wait_event") FROM "HouseRX/RDS/PerformanceInsights" WHERE db_instance_id = '$db_instance' GROUP BY "db.wait_event.name"
